mesajlar.mesaj:
Greetings Wigtonians.

Please do NOT put any food on the market. We have a fraudster and thief in town, who buys up every single scrap of food from the market,and then sells it for double. Additionally, he's been convicted of this in the past, and brags on his profile that he was convicted, and that he'll continue to do so.

If you have stat food to sell, please mail me directly, so I'm aware of what you have, and how much you are offering it for. If you are in need of food, also mail me, and I will either have it on hand in TH, or will let the others who have those items on hand to list them on the market for you on the market under your name.

Additionally, if you've sold items to this person, and you'll know it, as every bit of food you put on the market is bought up by 1 person, please send me the list of transactions.

Thank you for your understanding and cooperation. We need to make sure all of us have access to the stat foods we need to sustain ourselves, and to stop the fraud.

Emerald,
Mayor of Wigtow.

Bonjour calwenor et bienvenue !

Je suis le tribun de ce village et suis donc à ton entière disposition si tu as des questions ou besoin d'un coup de main pour quoique ce soit.

Tu peux m'écrire quand tu le souhaites, nous nous croiserons aussi probablement dans le refuge. Tu peux aussi visiter la Halle du village, le forum, tu trouveras le lien à la mairie.

L'idéal pour bien commencer dans le jeu, c'est de suivre pas à pas les premiers objectifs de passage de niveau et de ne pas hésiter à aller en taverne pour discuter avec les autres villageois !

À très vite calwenor,
